entry: In this illustrative purposive corpus, participants described uncertainty as a negotiated judgement across tool behaviour, data plausibility and self-assessment, with at least one account resisting the dominant pattern of initial tool trust.
Constant comparison across accounts, deliberate search for negative cases and reflexive comparison between early and revised interpretations.

Illustrative synthesis only: the worked material develops a theme of “oscillating trust”, in which participants alternate between trusting the computational tool and interrogating the data or their own code. One negative case describes immediate distrust of automated output.
